old_title: TGA clears weight loss tablets for use in Australia
new_title: TGA clears weight-loss tablets for use in Australia
old_text:
Daily weight loss tablet Wegovy cleared by TGA for use in Australia
In short:
A daily Wegovy tablet has been cleared for use in Australia.
It is the first GLP-1 approved by the TGA in oral form.
What's next?
The TGA is yet to review the packaging and production processes to confirm they meet standards before the product is released.
